title: Full time job and caregiving, for the ones who do how do yall do it?
discussion_signal: The thread describes caregivers using remote work, flexible hours, stacked appointments, and unpaid schedule changes to combine employment with care. Replies also describe quitting, reducing work, and treating caregiving as an additional uncompensated job.
linked_research_question: How unpaid care changes work schedules, career choices, income, and the practical time available for health and social life.
engagement: Visible vote counts were small; they are not prevalence or agreement.
limits: Indexed thread contains mixed dates and incomplete context
Self-reports are not verified employment or time records
